maintenance_led.reason: Builds, resurfaces and maintains roads, highways and runways; the site gives no split between new construction and maintenance work.

publicly_funded.reason: Highways, roads and airport runways for state and federal agencies, municipalities and military installations; private developers are the smaller part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Strategy is to acquire locally led infrastructure companies; recent Texas, Florida and Oklahoma acquisitions announced.

mission_critical.reason: Paving contracts are bid by public agencies and customers can switch contractors easily, despite owned asphalt plants and aggregates.

notes: The share of repair and maintenance versus new construction is not stated on the website.
